what: A Medium blogger compares payout speed: Payhip releases payouts within 24 hours while Gumroad takes 7 days to process, though both platforms share similar marketing tool features.
verbatim_snippet: "Payout — Payhip releases payout within 24 hours. Gumroad takes 7 days to process. Marketing tools (Upsell, cross-sell, discount code, email marketing, affiliate marketing) — Now these features are available on both platforms. But the newsletter is a little different."
notes: Author: Hazel Paradise. Disclosed affiliation: uses both Gumroad and Payhip; sells a Gumroad ebook. Page is publicly accessible on Medium; content extracted by research subagent but specific text not independently re-verified against page. Classified as provisional per conservative protocol. Competitors named: Payhip. Dimension: payout speed, features. Stance: neutral (chose Gumroad despite slower payouts). Specific numbers: Payhip 24-hour vs. Gumroad 7-day payouts.
